blocks.text: ILOILO CITY — The Iloilo City Operations Center (OpCen) has been placed on blue alert for this year’s observance of All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day, locally known as Tigkaralag. Under Executive Order / Memorandum Order No. 409 signed by Mayor Raisa Treñas, the blue alert took effect at 8:00 a.m. on Saturday, October 31, and will remain in effect until 5:00 p.m. on Tuesday, November 3. Despite some areas being flooded following Saturday morning’s downpour, early cemetery-goers, along with hired cleaners and painters, braved the floodwaters to prepare gravesites at Tanza Public Cemetery.
